# 🌐 NeuralOps v1.3.6: Extended Registry & Triton Matrix Expansion

## 🌟 Highlights
- **Attention Registry Scaled**: Scaled to over 100+ attention variants across 12 distinct mathematical families.
- **Compression Registry Scaled**: 72 compression engines integrated across SVD, quantization, and pruning.
- **Triton Hardware Autotuning**: 26 Triton JIT kernel modules profiled and autotuned on modern GPU architectures.
